description: This file defines a class `FormatWithProject` that implements the `ValueFormatter` interface to format entity values into project names by retrieving project data via a service trait.

classes.name: FormatWithProject
classes.description: A class implementing ValueFormatter to format entity values to corresponding project names.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the project by ID and returns its name if available, else null.
